d:
Around 1.27 crore Hindu voters whose names appear on panchayat electoral rolls are missing from Uttar Pradesh's final electoral rolls. At the same time, there has been a 1.65 per cent increase in the number of Muslim voters after the Special Intensive Revision (SIR).
These are the claims made by Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath. Yogi has challenged Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav, saying that the party will no longer demand a rollback of the SIR exercise.
